concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-compliance-guidelines-french-intermediary]] — 2026-09-15 France-qualified Business Accounts ORIAS intermediary-registration guideline for France-registered platforms serving French users, with director capacity, mandate, approval-dependent disclaimer and annual renewal; opening Capital wording conflicts with the Business Accounts body, and this is not legal advice or registration proof.
warnings: Opening description says Capital, while trigger, registration and disclaimer instructions say Business Accounts; preserve the product-label conflict rather than extending this guide to Capital.
